caption: The drawing shows a detailed, monochromatic depiction of a Western saddle, rendered primarily in shades of brown and tan. The saddle is adorned with intricate embossed floral and geometric patterns along the seat, fenders, and skirts. There are two stirrups, both decorated with similar patterns and leather straps hanging down. The horn is prominent at the top, and long leather strings and ties are visible hanging from the sides. The saddle blanket beneath is also ornately designed, seamlessly integrated into the overall composition. The drawing is set against a plain, light background with no additional objects or scenery, and the artist's name, "Frank C. Baaré," appears in the lower right corner.
title: Side Saddle
